Very unprofessional
Feb 2026 • Couples
We called in for dinner having read the reviews. First of all I would honestly say that the seating arrangement is amongst the most uncomfortable that I’ve ever experienced. The chairs are hard with very little cushioning. The food was good and well presented. When we came to order a sweet, we were told that the kitchen was closed and that the staff had left. At no point were we told or invited to order from the menu as the staff were leaving for the night. Only after pressing the staff was a sweet offered which we duly ordered. The sweets that were shown in the display cabinet are for display only and not for human consumption. The waiter was very good and did sort this out eventually but not a very professional representation of the Restaurant. The prices here are on the higher side and better service is expected. The only redeeming feature is that the young man who appeared to be the head waiter was very attentive and did go the extra Mile to sort this out

Written February 2, 2026
CHICLAND Hotel Da Nang
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We truly appreciate your comments as they help us improve our services.

First of all, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced during your dinner visit. We are sorry to learn that the seating arrangement was not comfortable for you and that the communication regarding the kitchen’s closing time was not clear. This is certainly not the level of service we aim to provide, and we understand how this may have affected your overall dining experience.

We are grateful for your positive remarks about the food presentation and the attentiveness of our staff member who assisted you. Your recognition of his effort means a lot, and we will be sure to share your kind words with him.

At the same time, your comments regarding service communication and guest experience have been shared with our restaurant team so we can review our procedures and ensure clearer information and more attentive service for our guests in the future.

Thank you once again for your honest feedback. We sincerely hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much more enjoyable dining experience.

Warm regards,
Chicland Hotel Management Team
